models.name: Bonsai 2 2B

engines.hardware: RTX 3060 12GB on the native Dawn WebGPU backend
engines.quant: Q2_0 ternary, WebGPU backend with PR #30914 (GET_ROWS + F32 activations); reported pp512 prompt processing 35 t/s -> 1900+ t/s, tg128 generation ~6-7x faster, baseline generation figure itself not stated
engines.engine_min_version: llama.cpp PR #30914 (Q2_0 on the WebGPU backend)

models.why: llama.cpp's Q2_0 support on the WebGPU backend took Bonsai 2 2B from CPU fallback to native GPU matrix multiplies: on an RTX 3060, prompt processing jumped from ~35 t/s to over 1900 t/s and tg128 generation got roughly 6-7x faster (the 35 t/s captured here is the prompt-processing baseline).
